title: Annual overlap check
objectives: Run the seven-point annual overlap check alongside the rebalancing review.
Say why one check is never enough.
body_md:
Overlap changes as fund managers trade, so one check is not enough. Annual overlap check (alongside the rebalancing review): count the equity funds; flag any increase since last year. Run an overlap check on the main fund pairs. Review the combined top 10 stocks and sector weights. Check for style drift: has a fund moved away from its stated style or market-cap focus? Before adding any new fund, check its overlap with what the client already holds. Note any scheme mergers or category changes announced by AMCs. Record findings and any agreed changes.

> **Investor takeaway:** Overlap changes as managers trade. Check every year, not once.
example: Annual check: fund count up from 4 to 7, one fund drifted from value to growth — flag both before adding anything new.
